title: A double cast to an integer rounds
verdict: rounds half away from zero; NaN, inf, out of range raise; sverify truncates first
description: `CAST(2.5::FLOAT AS NUMBER)` is 3, `-2.5` gives -3, `-0.5` gives -1, `0.49999999999999994` gives 0. NaN, ±inf and `1e40` raise `Number out of representable range`. `1e19` fits (`NUMBER(38,0)` is not 64-bit). To decimals it rounds half away from zero on the binary value (`2.675` to `NUMBER(10,2)` is 2.67, `0.125` to 2 places 0.13).
reference: `cast` to an integer with `float_to_int: TRUNCATE` and `cast_failure: ERROR` outside the range. sverify's SQL (`float_to_int`) casts `TRUNC(x)` after a range check that raises for NaN, ±inf and values outside 64 bits (`writer-float-to-int*`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT x, x::NUMBER(38,0), x::BIGINT, trunc(x)::NUMBER(38,0) FROM (VALUES (2.5::FLOAT), (-2.5::FLOAT), (3.5::FLOAT), (0.49999999999999994::FLOAT), (-0.5::FLOAT), (1e19::FLOAT)) AS s(x)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
